user_story: As a user, I want to update the title of an existing task so that I can correct or clarify it.

positive.title: Successfully update task title
steps: Change the title of the task.
positive.expected_result: The task title is updated successfully and displayed correctly in the task list.

positive.title: Update task title with special characters
steps: Change the title to include special characters (e.g., @, #, $, %).
positive.expected_result: The task title is updated successfully and displays the special characters correctly.

negative.title: Attempt to update task title with an empty string
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the title cannot be empty.

negative.title: Attempt to update a non-existing task title
steps: Try to navigate directly to a non-existing task's edit page.
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the task does not exist.

edge.title: Update task title to the maximum character limit
steps: Change the title to the maximum allowed character limit (e.g., 255 characters).
edge.expected_result: The task title is updated successfully, and the title is correctly displayed with the maximum character limit.

edge.title: Update task title rapidly
steps: Quickly change the title to 'Test Title 2'.
Quickly change the title again to 'Final Title'.
edge.expected_result: The last title change is applied successfully, and the task title reflects 'Final Title'.
